## Projects
- [Talk-to-Robot](https://github.com/YangLin14/Talk-to-Robot): Tested where a language model goes wrong when it turns spoken robot commands into target positions, separately from the robot's own controller.
- [WatchTower](https://cse110-sp26-group09.github.io/Watchtower-Course-Project/): A lightweight tool that shows web teams the errors, slowdowns and user activity on their live site.
- [TravelAGNTCY](https://youtu.be/T0EkJ9J_IQU): A travel planner where separate AI agents for flights, hotels and activities work together on one plan.
- [Stockroom](https://github.com/AdityaJadhav17/Stockroom): A shared inventory and purchasing app that records who approved what, and when.
- [Synthetic-to-Real Object Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/synthetic-2-real-object-detection-challenge): An object detector trained only on synthetic images, built to work on real photos.
- [Personal Tracker](https://github.com/AdityaJadhav17/Personal-Tracker): One app for deadlines, courses, notes and goals that runs entirely in the browser, with no account or server.
